title: Roswell witnesses describe threats made in 1947
summary: James Fox tells of Roswell witnesses describe threats made in 1947, about 1947 (interviews at the 50th anniversary, 1997) at Roswell, New Mexico, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: threats they'll be picking your bones out of the desert not they I had guys tell me this is what was said at the time

plain: Roswell is a town in New Mexico where, in 1947, people say something crashed and the military came to collect it. A UFO investigator named James Fox says that while he interviewed local witnesses around the fiftieth anniversary in 1997, several men told him they had been threatened at the time, with words like "they'll be picking your bones out of the desert." If true, it would mean people were scared into silence about what they saw.
